title: Detectable warnings at hazardous vehicular areas.
officialText:
If a walk crosses or adjoins a vehicular way, and the walking surfaces
are not separated by curbs, railings, or other elements between the pedestrian areas and vehicular areas, the boundary between the
areas shall be defined by a continuous detectable warning which is 36 inches (914 mm) wide.
